strategy: 1DTE directional debit spreads translated from intraday ETF signals
behavior: The command exits before loading credentials or contacting Alpaca when no family qualified.
The module contains no order submission, replacement, cancellation, exercise, or account mutation method.
A qualified family would authorize quote-side collection only; a live intraday signal runner requires a separate reviewed change.

translation.expiration: nearest expiration at least one calendar day away
translation.bullish: approximately 0.60 delta long call / 0.35 delta short call
translation.bearish: approximately 0.60 absolute-delta long put / 0.35 absolute-delta short put
translation.risk: net debit times 100, one contract only in any initial paper phase
